description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a healthtech software team building dependable tools for complex document workflows. You will own engineering work across backend services, AI integrations, APIs, and user-facing features that support practical, high-quality work.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build reliable APIs, backend services, and document processing workflows.

 - Deliver product features from technical design through release and iteration, collaborating with engineers and domain experts.

 - Integrate AI capabilities into production workflows, balancing output quality, speed, and reliability.

 - Improve interfaces for complex document tasks through full-stack collaboration.

 - Translate user needs into focused engineering plans and communicate technical tradeoffs.

 - Improve performance, investigate production issues, and strengthen testing, monitoring, and code quality.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Three to ten years of experience, including shipping and maintaining production web applications or services.

 - Strong programming skills in a modern language such as Python or TypeScript, with sound software design fundamentals.

 - Experience building APIs and backend services, and working with databases, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.

 - Experience with document processing workflows and integrating AI or LLM capabilities into production systems.

 - Practical skills in testing, code review, debugging, performance improvement, and production reliability.

 - Frontend experience and familiarity with products involving complex data or security needs are valuable.

 - Clear written communication, ownership, and an interest in applying technology to legal and other specialized workflows.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 USD, depending on skills, experience, and role scope. The role offers substantial ownership and influence over product decisions. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Fully remote within the United States.
